changes.comment: BREAKING: an open JsonSchema object (additionalProperties: true, including every fromJson object without additionalProperties: false) now carries undeclared keys through as validated JsonValue instead of silently dropping them, and refuses a non-object input instead of converting it to {}. The wire schema is unchanged. MCP-adapted tools, and any consumer-registered open schema, now forward undeclared keys, so a host gate that authorizes on declared fields will see keys it did not see before. Converters.jsonObject now drops an own "__proto__" key instead of assigning it (which replaced the copy's prototype); own keys in the result are unchanged. Adds OpenObjectStatic and typed object() overloads for additionalProperties: true.
